purpose: Terran Authority crackdown on smugglers at the Wormhole Market Hub, continuing the pale-stone and amber-light aesthetic study
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one cinematic environmental story image for Stellar Syndicates.
Primary request: A forceful Terran Charter Authority crackdown on smugglers at the Wormhole Market Hub, in the SAME sophisticated pale-stone, amber-lit architectural aesthetic as input image 1.

References: Image 1 is the primary STYLE, MATERIALS, LIGHTING and FACTION reference. Carry over its tactile ivory mineral surfaces, rounded monumental modernist architecture, elegant Art Deco proportions, narrow amber light slots, navy banners and antique-gold details. Create a new narrative scene; do not reproduce its coastline, mountains or building composition. Image 2 is only the official Authority insignia: a thin gold orbital ring intersected by three slender vertical spires of staggered heights. Place it accurately on banners and the customs hall wall.

Scene: Inside the pressurized grand customs concourse of the Wormhole Market Hub, a huge trading space station built around a stable wormhole. This concourse is an awe-inspiring civic space with chalky ivory walls, tall recessed arches, curved cantilevered mezzanines, broad ceremonial stairs, bronze railings and warmly glowing amber windows and strip lights. A huge sealed panoramic window behind the action reveals a luminous swirling indigo-violet wormhole with a dark central throat and fine cyan edges, contained by a slender ivory-and-brass orbital ring. A couple of small freighters wait at exterior docking berths, dwarfed by the gate. Clearly a spaceport and trading hub, with cargo lanes, freight crates, trader stalls and customs barriers integrated into the elegant architecture.

Main narrative, clearly visible in the foreground: an Authority squad has stopped a smuggling shipment and is taking control of the concourse. A stern commanding officer in a perfectly tailored long navy uniform with a high ivory collar and a restrained gold insignia directs the seizure with one firm, decisive gesture. Nearby, six human Authority officers wear realistically fitted ivory ceramic body armor over dark navy uniforms, with understated brass hardware and functional helmets. Their design is bespoke civic enforcement, visually consistent with this elegant architecture. Two keep compact weapons held at low ready, controlling the scene; one grips the arm of a detained smuggler whose wrists are restrained behind their back, another escorts a second smuggler away. The smugglers wear weathered rust-brown and charcoal civilian flight jackets and practical work trousers, their posture tense and defeated. A kneeling customs inspector has pulled open the false bottom of a battered freight crate, exposing tightly packed illicit luminous amber reactor capsules in protective racks. Seized crates and a small scanner make the discovery immediately legible. A few anxious merchants behind the lowered bronze customs barrier watch from the middle distance.

Composition: ONE finished landscape cinematic image, approximately 3:2. Eye-level 35mm documentary film still with convincing perspective. Human-scale action is the focal point and occupies the foreground prominently; figures about one-third to half the frame height, with anatomically plausible bodies and hands. Arrange officer, detained smugglers and opened contraband crate into one strong readable action group; no posed lineup. The tall, curved ivory concourse and spectacular wormhole establish location behind them without swallowing the action. Layered depth, a natural off-center composition, careful spacing and a legible silhouette for each main figure.

Lighting and mood: the reference's luminous desaturated pearl-grey and ivory palette, muted navy, aged brass, warm amber architectural light, soft cool fill from the wormhole. Photorealistic cinematic material rendering; subtle wear, stone grain, atmospheric depth, restrained highlights. Elegant, imposing, tense and ruthlessly orderly. Quiet institutional power made coercive. Preserve natural exposure and the reference's beautifully understated finish.

Constraints: no title, captions, signage lettering, interface, collage, watermark or border. No coastline or mountains. No neon cyberpunk, smoky battlefield, explosions or laser firefight. Avoid glossy plastic armor, franchise-character likenesses and visual clutter. Deliver one cohesive, polished scene.
